# 1 Enoch Chapter 94 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 94:5 — 'effaced' vs. 'erased' vs. 'wiped away'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "suffer-them-not to-be-effaced from-your-hearts" | 'Effaced' is precise; archaic register |
| LOGOS | "do not allow them to be erased from your hearts" | 'Erased' is natural modern equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "don't let them be wiped away" | Colloquial; shorter |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'erased.' 'Effaced' (EMET) is precise but archaic. PNEUMA's 'wiped away' lacks the cognitive dimension of the heart/mind.

---

## 94:6 — woe oracle structure: 'build unrighteousness and oppression'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "build-unrighteousness-and-oppression and-lay-deceit-as-a-foundation" | Literal compound structure |
| LOGOS | "build unrighteousness and oppression and lay down deceit as a foundation" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "build their empires on injustice and oppression, who lay deceit as their cornerstone" | 'Empires' and 'cornerstone' add interpretive color |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. 'Empires' (PNEUMA) is interpretive — the Ge'ez simply says 'build.' 'Cornerstone' replaces 'foundation' without textual basis.

---

## 94:7 — 'perish quickly' vs. 'suddenly perish' vs. 'perish swiftly'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-perish-quickly-in-the-judgment" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "shall suddenly perish in the judgment" | Emphasizes abruptness |
| PNEUMA | "will perish swiftly in the day of judgment" | Adds 'day of' which is in context |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'suddenly perish.' The Ge'ez emphasizes unexpected swiftness. 'Quickly' (EMET) is adequate; 'suddenly' conveys the shock of the destruction better.

---

## 94:8 — 'Woe to you, the rich' — address

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Woe to-you, ye-rich" | Literal; archaic plural |
| LOGOS | "Woe to you, the rich" | Formal; clear address |
| PNEUMA | "Woe to you, the wealthy" | 'Wealthy' as modern equivalent for 'rich' |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'the rich.' 'Rich' (plousios equivalent) is the standard Enochic term. Consistency with the tradition is important here.

---

## 94:10 — 'your Creator will rejoice at your destruction'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "your-Creator-will-rejoice-at-your-destruction" | Literal; shocking as written |
| LOGOS | "your Creator will rejoice at your destruction" | Formal; preserves the shock |
| PNEUMA | "Your own Creator will take satisfaction in your destruction" | 'Take satisfaction' softens slightly |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. The original Ge'ez is deliberately confrontational — God rejoicing at the destruction of the wicked is a theological provocation. PNEUMA's 'take satisfaction' softens it unnecessarily.

---

## 94:11 — 'a reproach' vs. 'an embarrassment'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-reproach-to-the-sinners-and-the-godless" | Literal: heruf = reproach/taunt |
| LOGOS | "a reproach to sinners and the godless" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "an embarrassment to sinners — a living reproach" | 'Living reproach' is added |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'a reproach.' PNEUMA's addition 'living' is not in the source. 'Reproach' (EMET/LOGOS) precisely renders the term.

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 5**
